    Where did Jake Diebler come from?
    Gibsonburg, Ohio
    Diebler was born in and grew up in the town of Gibsonburg, Ohio. He went to Fostoria High School for his first three years of high school and played basketball under his father, Keith Diebler.

    Why did Ohio State fire their basketball coach?
    The Ohio State basketball program decided to fire Chris Holtmann midway through the 2022-23 season. He had failed to meet expectations, and his players had stopped playing as hard for him as they did early in his tenure. They decided to hire Jake Diebler to take over his duties.
